brief:
Swedish actor Gustaf Skarsgård, known internationally for playing Floki in the television series Vikings, announced his public support for the Palestinian people, Shehab Wire reported. The actor joined an international campaign calling for the release of Palestinian prisoner Marwan al-Barghouti, adding his voice to growing calls for his freedom.

Skarsgård stated he does not fear potential consequences stemming from his position on the matter. The declaration marks his entry into activism surrounding the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, placing him among international figures who have spoken out on behalf of Palestinian causes in recent months.
